title: Rural Health Centres: Sanctioned vs. In-Position Staffing and Facility Gaps
summary: Audits Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Rural Health Statistics across all States and UTs to compare sanctioned Sub-Centres, PHCs, and CHCs against operational facilities and specialist doctor vacancies under IPHS norms.
jurisdiction: All India: 28 States and 8 Union Territories
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
scope: Compare required, sanctioned, and operational Sub-Centres, PHCs, and CHCs per State/UT
Verify specialist doctor, nurse, and technician shortfalls against IPHS norms
Track multi-year changes across published Rural Health Statistics cycles
